messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@auriga.ai>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ sync + example logs for Auriga

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks again for taking the time. We're preparing to run an internal SIG/CAIQ review and would like a short sync to: confirm the CAIQ mappings Redwood will provide, review the exact log samples we should share, and understand Redwood's recommended redaction / PII handling SOP before we transfer artifacts.

A couple quick questions up front so we can prepare the right samples:
- For CAIQ item "Logging and Monitoring" (section 4.x), can you provide a short summary of what log categories Redwood can share (auth, inference API, control plane ops, infra)?
- Is there a standard retention window and sanitization guidance you recommend for sample logs we drop into a secure bucket?

Can you do a 30-minute sync this Wed or Thu (our timezone PDT)? 11:00–13:00 PT window works for us.

We'd like the meeting recorded for internal audit.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Evan
Security Lead, Auriga AI

From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@auriga.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync + example logs for Auriga

Evan —

Thanks for the note. Wed 2027-03-24 at 11:30 PT works on our side; if that slips we can also do Thu 03/25 at 12:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite.

High-level answers to your pre-questions so you can start prepping:
- Log categories we can share (examples): auth/login events, token issuance/refresh, API request traces (inference requests with metadata, not user payloads), control-plane operational events (deploys, scale events), and system metrics (aggregated).
- Retention & sanitization: for security review we accept redacted samples with user identifiers hashed (SHA256) or replaced with stable pseudonyms. Default recommended sample window: 48–72 hours of events surrounding the reported incident or workflow; for coverage checks 7–14 days may be helpful but larger exports should be scoped first.

I'll attach a CAIQ template we commonly pre-fill and a short Redwood note on log redaction. Marissa will own the detailed CAIQ responses and the secure transfer method. Karthik will join for any tech-deep questions about request traces and KV/cache visibility.

Attachments: caiq_response_template.xlsx; redwood-caiq-guidance-logs.pdf (see attached).

-David
David Kim
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ sync + example logs for Auriga

Evan / Priya —

Quick notes ahead of today's call (I've dropped the fuller CAIQ answers into the attached PDF so you have something to review before we meet):
- Sample list: please provide (a) authentication events (login success/fail), (b) API access logs (time, path, response code, request id but NOT request payload), (c) inference request metadata only (latency, model id, region, request_id), and (d) control-plane deploy events if you can.
- Redaction: we prefer stable pseudonymization for identifiers (user-id -> pseudonym_####) or hashing; do NOT provide raw user content or input prompt texts. If you need to submit a small prompt for fidelity checks, isolate that to a single sanitized example and flag it.
- Transfer options: presigned S3 with limited expiry OR a secured SFTP drop. We can also accept a temporary access token for an encrypted transfer; we'll provide an upload address when you confirm which method you prefer.
- CAIQ scope: I'll pre-populate all infra and logging rows and mark items that require customer confirmation. On the call we'll align owner fields and timeline for evidence delivery.

I've attached: redwood-caiq-notes-20270322.pdf (CAIQ answers draft + redaction checklist).

See you at 11:30 PT — please add any other artifacts to the Drive folder linked below before the meeting.

Attachments: redwood-caiq-notes-20270322.pdf

Marissa
Security Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

- We'll prepare three 48-hour slices (auth, api_access, inference-metadata) and place them in a presigned S3 with expiry 72 hours after upload. We'll notify Marissa when the transfer is ready.
- For one small prompt sample we will anonymize identifiers and place that in a separate file marked SANITIZED_PROMPT.txt for your reviewers.
- Can you confirm the CAIQ timeline? We need the completed CAIQ draft by Mon 03/29 to meet our audit window.

Marissa — can you confirm you'll set the deliverable milestone (CAIQ draft) for 2027-03-29? Also confirm whether Redwood needs any signed NDA addendum for log samples — our security team asked about legal guardrails.

Thanks,
Evan
